source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
reference: Tăɣerma anta t-ămos agna n ăɣref ǝyen yuẓan ǧir imăzzaɣen n akal ǝyen, xdamen, tǝlalen ǧir-asen.

reference: Teɣasiwin iru saḍanen tent deɣ idraren dd tiɣezziwin d idagan wihaḍnin nn taḍant, saḍanen tent ibaraḍen miɣ adddunet wi maqqarnin. Awaɣ kanent daɣ ar azalaɣ deɣ idagan aǧutnin deɣ amaḍal.

reference: Wagonways twaknan s iseɣiren, awaɣ iǧa arakab nasen s uqqun nasen ɣur ayes yekna ayǧen ful rakab nasen ful aberaqa wahaḍen.
hypothesis: Kuddeɣ as karitan n karitan aqqalan ɣas n ihandagan n ahishk n ahishk, ijjan i i karitan wi ijjan i ad ikfan azruf maqqoran d ijjit n alxidmat tan maqqornen hullan fal abara tan wi ojjaran n azzaman wen

source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
reference: S tizart, yetwakna ɣas s iseɣɣir. Ḍeffer awin, eǧrawen yuf as sitin taẓuli bac ad yeṣṣuhet.
hypothesis: Crossties aqalan atiwazayan dǎɣ azaman ən azaman fal asikin ən tiritan dǎɣ edag. Agudendǎɣ, asukna as tiritan aqalnat atiwazayan ogarnen alxidmat as aqalan ilan əmik ən asikin fal edag.

source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
reference: Awaɣ iǧa t yeqqel yekna, bacin tilekkatin ti ntaɣn iseɣɣir rriiẓant ful taẓuli taɣ.
hypothesis: Awen eqqal alxidmat taqqal a oharnen mucham asuj eqqal a ojjaran ijjit n tikarsiwen n egad n karitan

source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
reference: Ḍeffer awin, ekkasen tilekkatin ti n iseɣɣir deɣ 1767. Eknan tilekkatin ti n taẓuli.
hypothesis: Daɣ azzaman, timirwen n aɣalay iknanen edag n timirwen n aɣalay daɣ awatay wan 1767, ijjit n tirma tan n aɣalay n aɣalay

source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
reference: AIsllal wazzaren n assikel yemmus tikli, ahales yessinta deɣ tikli ful sin iḍaren aylan sin imelyunen n awatay as yeqqel Homo Erectus (ahales yebdaden).
hypothesis: Assuhu wa ezzaran eqqal aqqal aqqal nen, addinat issintan aqqal nen s tizarat iwityan n issin n milyon n awatay s efes n Homo Erectus (as ijja almaɣna net awadim s tizarat)

source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
reference: Wi ten yerrunin, Australipithecus war ddubin tikli s tibeddi.
hypothesis: Awadim wa ezzaran nasan, Australopithecus war eqqal aqqal nen aqqal nen aqqal nen

source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
reference: Llanin deɣ Australopithecus 4.2 ar 3.9 n lmelyun n awatay wi yebdadnin ful sin ḍaren, bacin Sahelanthropus yebded ful sin ḍaren aylan n sa lmelyun n awatay.
hypothesis: Təmusne tan ən bipedal aqalan atiwagan dǎɣ Australopithecus fossils ən 4,2-3,9 milliontan ən awatay, ahuskat as Sahelanthropus adobat adiqil agaraw dǎɣ əsin əmik ən karad milliontan ən awatay.

source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
reference: Neddub ad nessint deɣ tamudri n asimɣer n amaḍal, neddub daɣ ad neǧǧeh deɣ tidukkilin ti yukṣaḍnin ful amaḍal d amukes n awa yekman id yeglanin.
hypothesis: Ad d-n-izjar ad n-t-id-izjar daɣ alɣalim, addobat nen ad-n-id-izjar daɣ akinnas n alɣalim, ad addobat nen ad-n-t-id-izjar daɣ alxidmat i ad-n-as-t-id-aqqil n-as-t-id-ikfa daɣ azzaman wa ezzaran

source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
reference: Nta hund turnha yecmin, as trid amukkes n ikannasen lazem ad teǧmayed awa ten id yessintan wa ten teksed.

source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
reference: Ayǧen deɣ paleonthologist flasen s tamadurt tan dinosaurs ar acalaɣ. Nǧani hasen iǧḍaḍ.
hypothesis: Paléontologuen ajotnen assa amosan as taqqimt iyyat n dinosaur tan tajja tolas taqqal tamudre assa.

source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
reference: Ayǧen n addunet war ǧanin i igḍaḍ dinosaurs inin ila ifrawen.
hypothesis: Addinat ajotnen war axkamnen fal as aqqalan dinosaur tan fal as ilan tifawt d addoben ad afran

source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
reference: Bacin llan iharaten ǧǧutnin deɣ igḍaḍ yellan deɣ dinosaur.
hypothesis: Mašan illanat haratan ajotnen fal iɣerwan wi har ajjudi iknanen dinosaur

source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
reference: Llan iḍaren s ickaren, tarwen tisadalin, tidawen ful iḍaren wi n ḍeffer hund T-Rex.
hypothesis: Ilsan tizarat n ijjit d tizarat, iknan itir, d azzamanan fal ijjitan nasan n s data chund T-Rex

source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
reference: Azalaɣ ak iselkimen sexdamen deɣ amuken nasen haret iyen ǧanin as binary numbers code.
hypothesis: Əmik kul ən ordinateurtan atiwətkalnen dǎɣ azzaman wen aqalan atiwətkalnen fal asikin ən isalan atiwətkalnen dǎɣ dumu ən maɗinan ən binari.

source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
reference: A binary number yeddub ad yil lqima iyet ɣas, 0 miɣ 1, uṭunen wiɣ ǧanin asen binary digits - miɣ bits, deɣ amawal n aselkim.
hypothesis: Əmik ən binary adobat adiqil iyan dǎɣ sin alqimetan, amos 0 meɣ 1, əd maɗinan aqalan atiwasanan sund əmik ən binary - meɣ bit, ye amitkalan ən jargon ən ordinateur.

reference: War tdubbid ad tezdayed turna tan ssem, bacin as tecwaḍeḍ awadem yessuɣel d awa ila deɣ tarfa nit, ezday inin awadem waɣ iswa miɣ ikca ssem.

hypothesis: Asuj wa ojjaran n asuj n dax eqqal aqqal aqqal n ehan ehan ehan n isuj meɣ isuj n ehan n ehan

reference: Tǝfert tan bug axdǎmǎn sar ǝs entomolojist tan s almǎɣna n tǎqqǝmt ten n ǝmudǎrǎn.
hypothesis: Isim wan bug exdam entomologist tan daɣ almaɣna n almaɣna i taqqimt ten n insect tan

reference: Tǝfert ten tǝzjǎr ǝd jǎmǎɣ wan aru ǝd Bed-bugs,amosnen ǝmudǎrǎn ǝjǎnen ǝ asǎmmǎdǎs n addinǎt.

reference: Assǎssin-bugs d Bed-bugs fuk nǎsan amosǎn ǝmudǎrǎn tǎhǎjǝnen daɣ ǝskǎk nǎsan, ǝjǎnen ǝ tǎmudre daɣ askok meɣ ehǎn n ǝnǎftǎɣǎn nǎsan.

reference: MS nta turhna ta yeggaten iɣef, iɣesan dd iẓerwan n awadem ar yewweḍ tiṭṭawin nit.
hypothesis: MS eqqal aqqal aqqal n aqqal n sistem wan tisirwen n ammas eqqal n eɣanni, spinal cord d optic nerve

source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
reference: Agamay usnan isken-d, tuntawin rnint ugarent dag PS miden.
hypothesis: Umaɣ eɣra as tiɣarmaten aqqalan a hinan alwaq iyyan i ad ilanen MS hullan fal irum

source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
reference: Imerrawen dubin ad nhaḍen war ihussay full-sen miɣ full arra kud sidwellen anubi.
hypothesis: Awar n awadim addobat ad iktab as war eqqel a fal ijjan alfayda nasan meɣ alfayda n awadim nasan as aratan awadim

source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
reference: Imerrawen wiɣ dubin ad aktun kud ran ad sedwellen inuba.
hypothesis: Tənaten tin adobatnat ad akfən asukni ən asukni ən awadim ye awadim.

source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
reference: As iga asedwel, imerrawen n anubi wi n tidet igdal-asen ak haret full anubi, ad yekk imerrawen wi haḍnin.
hypothesis: Daɣ asuj, imawlan win aru issarhan alxaq nasan n awadim i as awadim iyyan ad eɣra awadim n awadim

source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
reference: Iswi wa meqqaren n musnet anta ad sanen mamek amadal igal s tamella n tarayt n musnet. Tarayt taɣ tilil miden wi n musnet.
hypothesis: Almaɣna wa ezzaran n science eqqal ad issin almaɣna n immik wa s axdam alɣalim s immik wan science. immik wen eqqal daɣ tiditt almaɣna n farak n science ajjotnen

source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
reference: Anta warǧi ɣas-nnit, asekyed anta akayad iyen kanen-t full ad sugeggen iyet miɣ ugar n turdiyin, ad sestennen, titar, ad acwaḍen cund wa tagen dag musnet.
hypothesis: War eqqal ɣas, akayad tolas akayad eqqal akayad axdaman i asukni n iyyan meɣ ajjotnen n mirda tan addoben, asistan n isistanan d akayad eqqal deɣ almaɣna n farak n science

source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
reference: Imusnawen n agama d wi n lfalsafa gan musnet--nsen full idrisen irun, dag tizzar, win n Bible s latin.
hypothesis: Imusanan ən təbiɗawt ad filozoftan əganen asukni fal əmik ən əmik ən tənna əd, dǎɣ tartit, fal Bibliyat dǎɣ latin.

source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
reference: Ihǎnayan n-Aristot ǎmossan a-itiwaqbalan fal awa ǎqqǎlan isistanan fuk fal alçim, haddid musnat tan tiwittawen.
hypothesis: Awen eqqal a oɣadan ikayadan win Aristotle fal haratan fuk n science, ahan psychology

source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
reference: As teqqel musnet ta n Lyunan s deffer, Ikalen wi n afella grawen iman-nsen tebba-sen musnet d iki wa n lfalsafa.
hypothesis: Alwaq wa id musnat n Greek tajja fal almaɣna net, West taqqal as war ila almaɣna n filozofi tan n Greek d science

source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
reference: Acalay ggent acwaden-ten dag musnet n kaya n tafekka n awadem, antani ilan full asaɣet tan byulogiya.
hypothesis: Timizdaɣ ajjotnen n physiology d alxal ahanen almaɣna hullan fal a hin n endogenous cycles d efes nasan s biological clocks

source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
reference: Acala n imir wi war nettara full idracen wi n tiniri, full haraten n imudiren, gan-asen ilkaḍen cung backeria, ickan, axuten.
hypothesis: Timizdaɣ n azzaman war n aqqel alwazab n isalan n azzaman n ajjama, aqqalan iktab tan i addinat ajjotnen n tamudre, ahanen bacterie tan, fungi tan, ihishkan d arizzej

source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
reference: Asaɣet tan biyoloji anta oscillators wi ilkamen ialus n imir ilelli, anta aba-has idracen wi n tiniri.
hypothesis: Awatiwən ən tamudre aqalan oscillators atiwəjanen imanes adobatnen ad aqalnen agudiyan ən azzaman ən asikin ən asikin harwa dǎɣ winan eqel ən haratan wi ahanen.

source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
reference: Akayad n musnet iga Hershey d Chase, seknen-d DNA illa daɣ mantatu n awadem.
hypothesis: Irum wan Hershey d Chase eqqal iyyan daɣ isalan wi maqqornen as DNA eqqal harat n etari

source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
reference: Hershey d Chase Saxdemmen phage miɣ virus iyen full ad knen DNA n wiɣ dag lbaktirya.
hypothesis: Hershey d Chase axdaman fal phage tan meɣ virus tan i asuj n DNA nasan daɣ bacteria

source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
reference: Knan sin ikayaden, iyen ADN wa n pharge d fusfur ta haḍet pritin wa n pharge d sulfur n afa.
hypothesis: Əganen issin irumən ən asikin ən ADN dǎɣ phage dǎɣ phosphore radioactif meɣ protein ən phage dǎɣ sulfur radioactif.

source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
reference: Abeddel yeddubi ad yell haret n tigawin war ulin ilmend n tawsit n ameskel, tixutert n tafult n ADN iɣhan, kud isan wi iɣhan antani isan wi n twekki.
hypothesis: Mutations addoben ad ilanat ichikilan ajjotnen n almaɣna tan ajjotnen s almaɣna n ichikilan n mutation, almaɣna n achrut n genetic material eha tolas as izirwan eha izirwan n germ line

source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
reference: Ɣas ameskel neɣ abeddel dag isan twekki dubin ad altaɣen inuba. Ameskel dag ideg wa haḍen yeddub ad yenɣ isan wiɣ miɣ ad yeǧ saratan.
hypothesis: Mutations daɣ izirwan n germ tan ɣas addoben ad awidnen i addinat, alwaq wa id mutations daɣ edag iyyan addoben ad awidnen tamattant n izirwan meɣ cancer

source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
reference: Atireggac dag tiniri yettawiy-d ddinet wi irhan tiniri full inin ad hanyen icken d axuten i yellan diɣ.
hypothesis: Aɣazan n alxălim eɣra addinat wi illanen hullan s alxidmat n alxălim n ihandagan n alxălim i ad amăd n alăkum, eha ihăndăgan d ihăndăgan n ihanan

source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
reference: Llan iweẓlan wi kanen diɣ cund agadel n awuten n tiniri miɣ wi n aman, asiwer, acaweḍ n igḍaḍ, atireggac dag igelmam, akayad n isalen full tameddurt n imudiren.
hypothesis: Almitalan n alxidmaten n edag ahanen asuj, asuj, asuj, akayad n arizzej d asuj n parks d teɣare n isalan fal ecosystem

source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
reference: Cund, asukel, asiwer, alamad wan Organgatuangs dag Borneo.
hypothesis: Almital eqqal asuj, ikitban n issin d teɣare n organgatuang tan daɣ Borneo

source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
reference: Ak tufat, aK awadem ad ikel s akal-nit ad yak akal wa haden s tureft, dag abaraq ad imhay anta d ddinet wiyaḍ akkal-d s ikalen wiyen usi-n berri akal waɣ.
hypothesis: Alwaq kul n tazzayt, addinat ijjan daɣ timizdaɣ n akal s auto tan i ad arhan s alxidmat nasan tolas ijjan win iyyad s alxidmat nasan eqqal edag wa s ijjan

source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
reference: Dag tigawin tiɣ n asiweḍ, ddinet mdan cund inin, qqanen berrin anagraw iyen n asiweḍ cund lkarhabat d tureft.
hypothesis: Daɣ asuj wen n transport n amutti fuk n addinat aqqalan daɣ achrut n anmizlay d asukni n sistem n transport eqqalan fal auto tan n addinat

source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
reference: Misnet teskan-d, tadamsa taɣ n lkarbun tga ameskel hullan dag biosphere full ideg wa yugdan, anta imestan amahaẓ n ddinet full lmaryun n iwetyan.
hypothesis: Science taqqal a hin isalan as ta-ite ta maqqorat tan carbon t-id-issukni biosphere daɣ iyyan n addawla tan net n alɣalim s ijjan efes n awadim daɣ iwityan win issin n milyon n awatay

source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
reference: Ak iyen icirek dag aɣrem dag asiweḍ. AK war iri anagra waɣ n asiweḍ.
hypothesis: Kuddeɣ eqqal addinat wi ahanen alxidmat daɣ tamazduq tolas axdaman sistem tan n transport

source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
reference: Dag ikalen win igudin war tsaled i inaw inin taɣara n aman war tehhusay miɣ abaraqa inḍaw.
hypothesis: Daɣ addawla tan wi idaynen war n ijjit isalan n isuj n almaɣna n aman meɣ n alɣibad wi idaynen

source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
reference: Ma full anagraw n asiweḍ war igudi, ma full abada ixrak? Imusnawen n alalen asiweḍ war ddubin ? miɣ haret iyen a yegrawen?
hypothesis: A fal sistem tan n transport iknanen isuj chund win, awa s iknanen alwaq iyyan alwaq iyyan? inejiniya tan n transport war n aqqel a fal war n aqqel a fal illan harat n almaɣna

source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
reference: Traffic Flow anta musnet ta itakyaden tigaw n wi isaglen d tikli n tureft ǧir sin idgen d tigawin ilan ǧir-isen.
hypothesis: Traffic flow eqqal teɣare n akinnas n imosan d isuj jir titbaqet tin issin d almaɣna nasan

source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
reference: Tikerẓi n amellil, akayad n tikli n tureffin isuheḍ full ini war teddubi ad tesned kud amadem wa yessegli isxa tamiḍi full tamiḍi.
hypothesis: Har ajjudi, teɣare n akayad n tikarsiwen taqqal aqqal a ojjaran fal as alxal n awadim war addobat ad eɣna s a hin n 100 n issin

source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
reference: Dag tidawit, midden wi yesseglen llan tiyati, saglen sullan, awa yessilcel tikli n turafa sullan, teddubit a tessekned s musnet n asiḍen.
hypothesis: Dǎɣ asuj, iməššəɣilan aqalnat atiwaɣranen dǎɣ tabarat ən alməɣnat; dǎɣ awen, əmik ən asikin aqalnat atiwaɣranen dǎɣ alməɣnat əd adoben adiqilan atiwaɣranen dǎɣ maɗinan.

source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
reference: Full inin ad seknen tikli illan diɣ abaraqa knan kraḍ n assaɣen : 1) Tikli, 2) asget, 3) Tazla dag tikli.
hypothesis: Ye asiwad ən asuj ən asuj, təbiɗawen aqalnat atiwagan jar karad haratan wi maqarat: (1) asuj, (2) asuj, ad (3) azaman.

source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
reference: Aseɣ wiɣ itilal full asuɣen d amuken n iweẓlan n abaraq.
hypothesis: Timizdaɣ tin tinat taqqal nat afor daɣ akayad, edey d alxidmat n titbaqqa n abara tan

source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
reference: Ican antani axuten wi izaren dag aferfer, adubi n tikli incil-asen ad arwlen, ad awyen titetti d tmidiyin yulaɣen.
hypothesis: Isuj aqqalan arizzej wa ezzaran ijjan afanaz. Təmusne nasan n afanaz t-issəkna as afanaz n imudaran tolas ijraw n aɣaz d imudaran s afanaz hullan

source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
reference: Haraten n ican ddubin ad tellen afriwen-nsen full tafekka-nsen.
hypothesis: Ijjit n ihishkan ilan alfayda n as addoben ad iknan ifridan nasan s afalla n taɣissa

source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
reference: Waɣ ikfa-sen idgan wi induknin agetten i axutten ad ffren.
hypothesis: Awen eqqal a fal ilan edag ajjotnen n idagan madroynen i asukni daɣ imudaran

source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
reference: Acel waɣ, ɣas ican n tinin d ican n mayu raddubi ad tellen ifrawen-nsen.
hypothesis: Dǎɣ amarad, əmik ən haratan winan adobatnen assuhu ən tabarat ənes aqalan tigitan ən dragon əd tigitan ən mayfly.

source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
reference: Agim n iwetyan ar deffer, ales iyen isem-nit Aristarchus ina anagraw n tafuk itaǧen full tafuk.
hypothesis: Daɣ harkuk n awatay, awadim s isim net Aristarchus allaɣat as sistem wan tafuk eɣaz tafuk

source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
reference: Haret n ddinet aktan tidet a yenna beccan wiyeḍ akten warǧi tidet awa yenna. Full anagraw n tafuk igal full amadal,( akked itran wiyeḍ).
hypothesis: Addinat iyyad allaɣen as ila tiditt mucham addinat ajjotnen amosan as alɣalim eɣaf akal, ahan tafuk (d etran iyyad)

source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
reference: Waɣ tenned tidet, full ini war tsaled kud amadal igal, tidet miɣ?
hypothesis: Awen eqqal a hinan, fal as akal war eqqel amosan as eɣlal, eɣla?

source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Anǧi wa n Amazon anta hegaret meqqar wan sin dag amadal.yettawiy 8 ṭam n awa ttawyen inǧa wiyeḍ dag aman.
hypothesis: Amazone eqqal asiflan wa ezzaran tolas wa maqqoran daɣ akal eqqal eqqal eqqal eqqal eqqal ezzaran daɣ akal eqqal ezzaran daɣ akal eqqal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran daɣ akal ezzaran

source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
reference: Anǧi wan Amazon anta wa meqqaren ǧir inǧan n amadal, anta illa sḍis n miles daɣ imir iyen.
hypothesis: Amazone eqqal deɣ asiflan wa ojjaran daɣ akal, daɣ azzaman tan eqqal 6 n mil tan n tijilil

source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
reference: Snatet tmearwin 20 ful timiḍi n aman win amaḍal wa-d-iffalen iɣezran d yenɣel daɣ iǧiriw yeffal-d Amazon.
hypothesis: 20 n isalan n aman wi id izjaranen daɣ asiflan n aman daɣ aman eqqal nen daɣ Amazon

source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
reference: Iɣazzer wa meqquren daɣ Amazon ila 6,387 n Km( 3,980 miles). Yessidaw aman n iɣazeren ɣared-nsen.
hypothesis: Amazone taqqal tamadal n 6.387 km. Tassəwəj aman daɣ ijitan ajjotnen n aman wi madroynen

source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
reference: Kunta amukken n pyramid s ikkadiwen yelkam har ticrayet n tamnukla ta trut, pyramid win Giza war ifniẓ taceǧrit-nnit d ammek ulaɣen wa-s-yedday.
hypothesis: Kuddeɣ as edey n pyramid tan daɣ aɣalay eqqal har samando n alxakum wan aru, pyramid tan win Giza war n aqqel harkuk a ojjaran daɣ iddikud nasan d anmizlay n teknoloji n edey nasan

source: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
reference: Egyptians wi iruwnin n tamnukla ta teynayet ekkunen daɣ takkassit n wi-hasen-yezzarnin, wa-s-kallad tella a yuǧaren aǧiw n awatay.
hypothesis: Masar tan win aru n alxakum eynaynen amosan daɣ timusnawen n wi ezzaran nasan, wi illanen alwaq wen hullan n awatay

source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Midden win aɣrem wan Vatican ugdan d 800 n awadem. Yeqqal akkal wan ntukken hullan ilulleten daɣ amaḍal d akkal wa-daɣ efnaẓen midden hullan.
hypothesis: Iddikud n Vatican eqqal 800 n awadim. Eqqal addawla ta maqqorat n alistexlal daɣ alɣalim tolas addawla ta ilan ichaɣib ojjaran

source: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
reference: Aɣrem wan Vatican issaxdam tawalt tan Italian daɣ tssertit-nit d anmiǧrah wan dimaɣ.
hypothesis: Vatican City t axdam s italienne daɣ achareɣa net d majrad n alxakum net

source: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
reference: Italian, daɣ teqqal tawalt tan hak acel ta saxdamen a-yeǧin daɣ midden wi iwiẓlatnin daɣ tamnukla, daɣ elwaq wad-saxdamen Latin daɣ tidfaṣkawin tin eddin.
hypothesis: Italienne eqqal awal wa s axdaman addinat ajjotnen daɣ alxakum mucham Latin t amos awal wa s axdaman daɣ alxidmaten n addin

source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Imezzaɣ win Vatican emdan emussen Roman Catholic.
hypothesis: Addinat fuk n Vatican City aqqalan Roman Catholic

source: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
reference: Kallad essanen eddunet ful tayunin tin chemical tin basic cund uraɣ d aẓref d taẓuli men iwetyan iruwnin, as teddubid aten-teǧrawed daɣ tiniri s udem-nsen wa yezzaren d yeẓewet a ten-teǧrawed s allalen wi yruwnin.
hypothesis: Addinat issanat fal haratan win kimikal chund eɣad, azruf d tazoli daɣ azzaman wan aru, fal as ahanen fuk adoben ad aj in daɣ ahinzazaɣ daɣ dumu n akal tolas aqqalan a hinan i asuj s isuj n aru

source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
reference: Aristotle, philosopher, iǧa turda as haraten emdan eknan daɣ tasertit n tayunt miɣ a-yuǧaren ekkuẓet tayunin. Emusen amaḍal d aman d aḍu d timsi.
hypothesis: Aristote, filozof, iktab as haratan fuk aqqalan a fal iknan harat iyyan meɣ ajjotnen n haratan win karad: akal, aman, ahinzazaɣ d afanaz

source: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
reference: Awaɣ yulah d ekkuẓ elxalen win haraten( daɣ asilkum iyen) yeqqur, yebdaǧ, gas d ahu hullan yurda as eqqalen kayaten wiyuḍ ful ad eknin awa nhannay.
hypothesis: Awen eqqal a ojjaran chund karadat alɣalim tan n harat (dǎɣ almaɣna olahan): aśohen, azilzam, gaz əd plasma, ahuskat as iktab as amutti nasan dǎɣ haratan eynaynen ye igi ən awa iknanen.

source: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
reference: Alloys mukannin hullan daɣ asserti n metals essin miɣ a t-ugaren. War hin-tetewed as lant a-yeǧin daɣ tayuni daɣ periodic table.
hypothesis: Alloy tan aqqalan ahanay n metal tan issin meɣ ajjotnen war n ittu as illanat haratan ajjotnen daɣ table périodique

source: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
reference: Tayunin cund calcium d potassium ǧan-ten daɣ metals.hullan, illi daaɣ metals cund aẓref d oraɣ.
hypothesis: Elements chund calcium d potassium aqqalan metal tan hak id metal tan chund silver d gold

source: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
reference: Teddubid daɣ ad tekreced alloys ti hant tayunin tintuknin ti wer-nmus metals cund carbon.
hypothesis: Adobat ad tiliɣ iritan wi ahanen iddikud n haratan war n aqqel metal chund carbon

source: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
reference: Awa yhan amaḍal imda ikna daɣ hareten. Hakk haret ikna daɣ tiffulin ti-ntuknin ti-s-itiwenna atoms.
hypothesis: Haratan kul daɣ alɣalim aqqalan ahanen harat haratan fuk aqqalan ahanen harat n ihandagan wi maqqornen s isim nasan atoms

source: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
reference: Atoms saǧrawen takkunt har taǧacnet aylan trillions d-esnet daɣ alwaq wad-tecray tawinest tadaɣ.
hypothesis: Atoms aqalan ogarnen aśohen har as triliontan ənes adoben ad aqalnen atiwəjanen dǎɣ tabarat ən samando wen.

source: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
reference: S ammek waɣ, aɣanib kallad imus amidi ulaɣen n a-yeǧin daɣ midden as d-iǧmeḍ.
hypothesis: Dǎɣ awen, pencil eqal amidi ən adinat ajotnen agud wa id eqal atiwaɣran.

source: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
reference: A yessarhanen, daɣ ideg wadaɣ d-ecraynen ammeken win akatab aynaynin, aɣanib yezzizubet ar status d asexdem ifnaẓen.
hypothesis: Daɣ as ijja awen, s immik wa eynayan n ikitban, alkittab war eqqel a fal itkal alxidmat net

source: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
reference: Dimaɣ midden katraben tirawin s amatuǧ wan computer, war tahaẓin abadah asamsad-n-aɣanib.
hypothesis: Addinat amarad iktabnat isalan fal əmik wan ordinateur, war ilzam ad əknanen haratan ən asukni.

source: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
reference: War neddubet ɣas har-nessesten ful awa-s-yeddubet ad umas keyboard as d-icray haret iyen haḍen.
hypothesis: Adobat awadim ad issarham awa ad eqqil tasassaɣrit alwaq wa id eqqal harat eynaynen

source: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
reference: Asselfeɣ-n-tuẓanet itaǧ ful principle as itawi energy ful ad ikenn nucleus s a-yeǧin daɣ protons d neutrons.
hypothesis: Bomba tan n fission taqqal axdam fal isim n as eqqal assahat i ad ikna nucleus s proton tan ajjotnen d neutron tan

source: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
reference: Cund ad enteked tureft ta-teẓayet ful tatakurt. Ad tuẓaned nucleus amir wa haḍen yessdarfat daaɣ haret daɣ energy tadaɣ.
hypothesis: Dǎɣ asukni ən karitan ogaran asukni ən tabarat. Asukni ən nucléus dǎɣ azzaman iyan izar ikna iyan ən tabarat.

source: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
reference: Haret daɣ atoms llan nuclei war-entamnin, awa issaken as inahil ad erẓin s tiwit teṣṣuhit miɣ war teṣṣuhet.
hypothesis: Atoms iyyad ilan nukle tan war n eqqel n alɣalim s almaɣna net as aqqalan a ti izjaran s asuj n ijjit meɣ war n eqqel n ijjit

source: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
reference: Amaḍal wan iwar yekna daɣ ikadiwen d idahi. Tasutalt tan berra itiwennas crust.
hypothesis: Akal wan ašal ən ašal eqal atiwagan ən təɣəšəɣulen ad əšəɣəl. Əmik wa dazarnen ən ašal ən ašal eqal atiwagan as əšəɣəl.

source: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
reference: Crust tellat aylan 70km daɣ aɣil wa yuhaẓen d 100km daɣ aɣil wa aɣil wa yuǧaǧen.
hypothesis: Akal eqqal har 70 km n tijililt daɣ achrut n ehan tolas har 100 km n tijililt daɣ achrut n ehan

source: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
reference: Iga isaddiden daw Maria, ihuharen daɣ ikallen eṭkalnin.
hypothesis: Aqqal a ojjaran daɣ maria tan tolas a ojjaran daɣ akal n akal

source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
reference: Iddubet as illi uǧar daɣ maria daɣ aɣil wa uhaẓen ful-inin crust tisadidet. Yeqqar haret nehilen ad awan lava afella n akal.
hypothesis: Adobat ad ille maria tan ajjotnen daɣ edag wa ehay fal as aɣalak eqqal a hinan tolas eqqal a hinan i lava ad taqqil s afalla

source: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
reference: Turdawin tin a-ihan-ammas ebdadnet hullan ful umuɣ n awa yessdawen midden d awa-ten-d-iǧabbaden.
hypothesis: Mirda tan n isuj aqqalan fal afuk n awa eɣnan addinat meɣ awa ijjan addinat ad akfnen

source: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
reference: Turdawin tidaɣ ǧannint as midden llan haraten d/miɣ n awa-ran wa-yhan ammas-nsen har ewwaḍen iwetyan win imawaḍen.
hypothesis: Mirda tan win allaɣen as addinat ilan ti ilzam nen d / meɣ isuj n addinat wi illanen daɣ iman nasan alwaq wa id aqqalan wi ojjaran

source: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
reference: Turdawin tiyaɣ tassenent tumast n midden wiyuḍ, isdiɣhalten haraten wi taǧnin d mamusen hareten win hassen ittilalalen ful ad eǧin haraten d war taǧin haraten wiyuḍ daɣ awa-han.
hypothesis: Mirda tan win akayad awa eqqal fal addinat iyyad ewaynen as eha haratan wi s itaj tolas awa eha haratan daɣ ahinzazaɣ nasan ewaynen ad axdamen meɣ war axdamen haratan iyyad

source: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
reference: Snatet turdawin ti-tiwazzayen enta as turda tan Hiarchy n tawssarit tan Maslaw d turda tan Factor wan essin tan Hertzberg.

hypothesis: Guaraní aqqalan taqqimt n kel akal ta taqqalat hullan ta taqqal dagh akal wan amarad n Paraguay tan alqiblat, izzaɣan chund imudaran n azzaman wi id izzaɣnen daɣ achareɣa n achareɣa

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Kalad teqel tcakou aɣrem n teɣrfin teyeḍ daɣ n tewsatin tin kel akal hund gayurcu d payrouga ,wi ded atwagaẓnin deɣ mehuya d asdiwen d ahayou n menan.
hypothesis: Taɣrimt tan Chaco taqqal ehan n taqqimen n tawseten tin kel akal chund Guaycurú d Payaguá, wi id izzaɣan s afanaz, ajaraw d asuj

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Deɣ^alqaren was 16 ad tekna baragway, tas kalad tetwezey s isem wan tiqitest tan tegzirin tin indiz, awad tid urawen imaǧaḍen win espan d kel akal win tidet.
hypothesis: Daɣ awatay wan 1500 Paraguay, s itawan " Province tan ti maqqornen n Indies", eqqal asilmad n ijjuch n kel akal n Espagne d taqqimen n kel akal

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: Asenten kel espan imir wan istiɣmar ta taqimet karaḍt temaḍ n awatay.
hypothesis: Iɣirman win Espagne issintan azzaman wan alisteɣmar wa eqqal har karadat n awatay

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Ɣur amuken n Asunicion, deɣ awatay wan afeḍ d semuset temaḍ d karaḍet temerwin d assa 1537, tadubet paragway iguz n aǧin deɣ agna nit d serhu nit, d tumast nit.
hypothesis: Darat asuj n Asunción daɣ awatay wan 1537, Paraguay taqqal ad t-id-isuj muchakil n addinat net d ismawan nasan

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.

hypothesis: Argentina taqqal atiwazayan fal as ilan taqqimt n polo d imuzaran wi ojjaran daɣ alɣalim

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.

hypothesis: Təmɣare ta maqqorat ən awatay təqal dǎɣ décembre dǎɣ idagan ən polo dǎɣ Las Cañitas.
